title: Chapter 81: Fierce Battle With Doriku
content:
Chapter 81: Fierce Battle With Doriku

Wang Shuo was immediately upset.

Seeing the more than 20 horse bandits rushing over again, Wang Shuo did not dare to take it lightly and immediately shouted: "Quick battle, deal with Doliku first."

The attack power of ordinary horse bandits is limited, and it is not a big problem to be hit by a few knives.

If he caught the flaw of Doliku's attack and attacked continuously, it would be fatal.

So Gong Zheng took the risk of being hit by the long axe and directly hugged the axe with both hands.

This attack cost him nearly 500 health points, which was a huge price.

If Ayub and others had not attacked in time, Gong Zheng would have been lifted into the air by Doliku's axe.

If he was lifted into the air by the axe, Gong Zheng would have been in great danger.

Wang Shuo also quickly drew his gun and stabbed Doliku's back waist directly, but the opponent's hard armor blocked the damage.

Gong Kai, who had been unknown all the time, found the right angle and shot an arrow at the horse's foot.

Shoot the horse first before shooting at the person. One strike will do the trick. The warhorse neighed, and its two front legs suddenly bent and fell forward!

Doliku and Gong Zheng both fell off their horses and rolled on the grass.

"Good job, Gong Zheng, you have done a great job!"

Before, everyone had thought about killing the opponent's warhorse first.

But Doliku, who was swinging a hatchet tightly, protected the horse's head in front and the horse's tail in the back, and had no chance at all.

Gong Zheng held the hatchet, which exposed Doliku's flaw.

"Purple Thunder Breaking Sky Strike"

Ayub saw Doliku lying on the ground, like a living target, and directly launched a big move.

"-800"

A huge damage value appeared on his head.

This strike was directly equivalent to the sum of the damage they had caused to Doliku before.

Wang Shuo was shocked that Doliku's defense was so high.

He still remembered that the last time he saw Ayub use this strike, he directly dealt 1200 damage.

Just when Wang Shuo was about to make another move, an arrow flew towards his forehead.

"Lord, be careful!" Guliji exclaimed.

Wang Shuo immediately turned around, retracted his spear, and deflected the arrow in front of him, but the attack on Doliku was also resolved.

The rest of the horse bandits finally arrived.

Wang Shuo thought to himself that it was not good.

"Don't let him get up."

The cavalry squad surrounded Doliku, while the horse bandits surrounded the cavalry squad.

The two sides fell into a stalemate of close combat.

The advantage of the cavalry was greatly weakened, but it was the same for both sides.

The people in the cavalry squad were constantly injured and their health began to drop.

Wang Shuo was very anxious.

Fortunately, he had bought some big red medicine before, so he could still hold on.

At this time, Dongfang Ling also rushed over, and she seemed to be indifferent to the war that was happening.

She smiled at Wang Shuo excitedly, "Wang Shuo, I'm so glad to see you!"

Wang Shuo rolled his eyes at her and said unhappily, "You're too happy too early. Can't you see we're surrounded?"

"Just a few petty thieves, for you, it's easy to catch them!" She smiled and continued happily, "If you can't beat them, I'm still here! I'm very powerful and can protect you."

Wang Shuo despised her in his heart. She was surrounded by a group of horse bandits and asked me to rescue her. She dared to say shamelessly, protect me!

Who gave you the courage?

"You'd better protect yourself!"

Wang Shuo was no longer distracted and focused on dealing with the horse bandits in front of him.

Wang Shuo had practiced the basic moves of "Dragon Spear Art" such as point, stab, pick, chop, and collapse very well.

Although he was under siege, he still handled it with ease.
